newsitem.title: UK: BZW analyst Pye takes new job at Flemings.
newsitem.headline: BZW analyst Pye takes new job at Flemings.

text.p: British independent investment bank Robert Fleming said on Friday it had hired Hugh Pye from BZW, the investment banking arm of Britain's Barclays Plc, as a banking analyst.
A Flemings spokeswoman told Reuters that Pye, 40, would be a director at Robert Fleming Securities "with responsibility for UK, European and emerging European banks research".

Pye is due to take up his new position in July. He started his career at Barclays in 1978, then worked at County NatWest as a financials analyst before moving to Flemings in 1989. He left the firm in 1993 to work at BZW.
Flemings has around 50 analysts covering 650 British and European stocks. The firm already has two insurance analysts.
